heroSubtitle: This website exists because you exist in my life.

paragraphs: To the one who makes my heart skip a beat,

I still remember the day we met—it was the day my life changed for the better. You came into my world like a gentle breeze, bringing warmth, laughter, and a kind of happiness I had never known before.

Thank you for being my safe haven, my biggest supporter, and my best friend. Every conversation, every shared smile, and every little moment with you is a memory I treasure. I promise to love you, cherish you, and stand by you through all of life's seasons.
With all my love, always and forever.

gallery.caption: Every step with you is a dream come true ✨
